// src/contexts/SuitContext.tsximport { createContext, useContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react';import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';type SuitType = 'classic' | 'architecture' | 'gamification';interface SuitContextType { activeSuit: SuitType; setActiveSuit: (suit: SuitType) => void; loading: boolean;}const SuitContext = createContext<SuitContextType | undefined>(undefined);export const SuitProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => { const [activeSuit, setActiveSuitState] = useState<SuitType>('classic'); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { // Cargar suit desde Firestore const loadActiveSuit = async () => { const docRef = doc(db, 'settings', 'ui'); const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef); if (docSnap.exists()) { setActiveSuitState(docSnap.data().activeSuit || 'classic'); } setLoading(false); }; loadActiveSuit(); }, []); const setActiveSuit = async (suit: SuitType) => { setActiveSuitState(suit); // Persistir en Firestore await setDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'ui'), { activeSuit: suit }); }; return ( <SuitContext.Provider value={{ activeSuit, setActiveSuit, loading }}> {children} </SuitContext.Provider> );};export const useSuit = () => { const context = useContext(SuitContext); if (!context) throw new Error('useSuit must be used within SuitProvider'); return context;};

export type RequestStatus =

| 'EN_ROUTE' | 'ARRIVED' | 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'COMPLETED' | 'CANCELLED';

export interface ServiceRequest {

status: RequestStatus;



// Cliente

customerLocation: GeoPoint;

// El "Pack Mariachi 900â‚¬"

serviceDetails: {

ðŸ§  2. El "Algoritmo de Matching" (Cloud Function)

Esta funciÃ³n se dispara cuando entra un nuevo request. Para el Mariachi de 900â‚¬, buscarÃ¡ grupos en Madrid que tengan disponibilidad, equipo propio y buenas reviews.

functions/src/dispatch/matchProviders.ts

import * as functions from 'firebase-functions';

import * as admin from 'firebase-admin';

export const onServiceRequested = functions.firestore

.document('service_requests/{requestId}')

.onCreate(async (snap, context) => {

const request = snap.data();

const db = admin.firestore();

// 1. Buscamos proveedores que encajen (Mariachi, Min 6 personas, Online)

const providersQuery = await db.collection('providers')

.where('services', 'array-contains', request.serviceDetails.category)

.where('status', '==', 'ONLINE')

.where('minGroupSize', '<=', request.serviceDetails.groupSize)

.get();

const candidates = providersQuery.docs.map(doc => {

const p = doc.data();

// Calculamos Score: (Distancia * 0.4) + (Rating * 0.6)

const score = calculateDistanceScore(p.location, request.deliveryLocation) + (p.rating * 20);

return { id: doc.id, ...p, score };

});

// 2. Ordenar por score y asignar

candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

const bestMatch = candidates[0];

if (bestMatch) {

return snap.ref.update({

status: 'ASSIGNED',

assignedProviderId: bestMatch.id,

assignedProviderName: bestMatch.name,

assignedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

});

} else {

// Si no hay nadie, alertar a Ops EAR

return admin.analytics().logEvent('DISPATCH_FAIL', { category: 'mariachi' });

}

});

Esto se implementa como un â€œDispatch Systemâ€ real (tipo Uber), pero con 3 decisiones tÃ©cnicas clave para que no se rompa: modelo de datos coherente, matching geogrÃ¡fico correcto y seguridad/reglas para tracking en tiempo real. Cloud Functions puede dispararse cuando se crea un documento (onCreate / onDocumentCreated) y eso encaja perfecto con tu evento â€œServiceRequest creadoâ€.

1) Antes de meter cÃ³digo: 5 decisiones (P0)

Â¿Gen 1 o Gen 2 de Functions? Si ya estÃ¡s en Gen 2, usa los nuevos triggers (onDocumentCreated/Updated) y evita mezclar estilos, porque cambia el SDK y el despliegue.â€‹

â€‹

Una fuente de verdad para tipos: tu src/types/dispatch.ts estÃ¡ bien como base, pero necesitas compartirlo tambiÃ©n con functions/ (monorepo o paquete compartido) para que frontend y backend â€œhablen el mismo idiomaâ€ sin drift.

Geo matching no es â€œGeoPoint queryâ€ directo: Firestore no te resuelve â€œcerca deâ€ solo con GeoPoint; lo estÃ¡ndar es usar geohashes o soluciones de geoqueries, y Firebase documenta el enfoque por geohash como forma razonable y eficiente con un campo indexado.

Seguridad del tracking: el cliente final (Adriana) no debe poder leer datos sensibles de otros servicios; esto se gobierna con Firebase Security Rules y permisos por documento/campos (por ejemplo: el cliente solo lee su service_request).

â€‹

Observabilidad: cada cambio de estado (ASSIGNED, EN_ROUTE, ARRIVEDâ€¦) debe registrar eventos y permitir auditorÃ­a, porque tus promesas (â€œgarantÃ­a en detallesâ€) se vuelven medibles.

2) Correcciones rÃ¡pidas a tu snippet (para evitar bugs)

En tu matching usas request.deliveryLocation, pero en el tipo definiste customerLocation y deliveryAddress; te falta un deliveryLocation: GeoPoint (o renombrar consistentemente).

TambiÃ©n estÃ¡s haciendo .where('minGroupSize', '<=', request.serviceDetails.groupSize); Firestore soporta esto, pero asegÃºrate de Ã­ndices compuestos si luego aÃ±ades mÃ¡s filtros, y mantÃ©n la query simple para evitar costes.

El â€œscoreâ€ debe separar distancia y rating, y la distancia debe salir de geohash/bounding box + filtrado final, no de una query â€œnearbyâ€ inexistente nativa (si no, escalarÃ¡ mal).

3) Arquitectura mÃ­nima (para tu caso â€œPack Mariachi 900â‚¬ / 100km / 6 paxâ€)

Colecciones recomendadas:

service_requests/{id}: request con status + scheduledFor + deliveryLocation (GeoPoint + geohash).

providers/{id}: mariachi/grupo con services[], minGroupSize, location (GeoPoint + geohash), status: ONLINE/OFFLINE, rating, capacityCalendar.

El matching en Cloud Function: 1) query candidatos por service + online + groupSize, 2) filtra por geohash â€œcerca deâ€, 3) rankea y asigna.

4) Tracking real-time â€œwowâ€ (sin riesgos)

Muestra al cliente solo lo que necesita (estado, ETA, nombre), no localizaciÃ³n exacta del proveedor si no hace falta (privacidad).

// src/layouts/architecture/components/ArchitectureHeroEnhanced.tsximport { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';import gsap from 'gsap';import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';export const ArchitectureHeroEnhanced = () => { const heroRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null); const subtitleRef = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null); const bgRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); useEffect(() => { if (!heroRef.current) return; const ctx = gsap.context(() => { // Parallax multinivel const tl = gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: heroRef.current, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 1.5, pin: false, } }); // Background se aleja lentamente tl.to(bgRef.current, { scale: 1.15, opacity: 0.4, ease: 'none', }, 0); // TÃ­tulo se eleva mÃ¡s rÃ¡pido tl.to(titleRef.current, { y: -200, opacity: 0, scale: 1.05, ease: 'none', }, 0); // Subtitle se eleva a velocidad media tl.to(subtitleRef.current, { y: -100, opacity: 0, ease: 'none', }, 0); }, heroRef); return () => ctx.revert(); }, []); return ( <div ref={heroRef} className="relative h-screen w-full overflow-hidden" > {/* Background con parallax */} <div ref={bgRef} className="absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center" style={{ backgroundImage: 'url(/images/hero-architecture.jpg)', willChange: 'transform, opacity' }} /> {/* Overlay gradient */} <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/60 via-black/40 to-black/80" /> {/* Content */} <div className="relative z-10 h-full flex flex-col justify-center items-center px-6"> <h1 ref={titleRef} className="font-serif text-hero text-white text-center" style={{ willChange: 'transform, opacity' }} > Trust Architecture </h1> <p ref={subtitleRef} className="text-xl text-white/90 mt-6 max-w-2xl text-center" style={{ willChange: 'transform, opacity' }} > IngenierÃ­a de experiencias donde cada detalle estÃ¡ auditado </p> </div> </div> );};

// src/layouts/gamification/components/GlowEffects.tsximport { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';export const GlowEffects = () => { const cursorGlowRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); useEffect(() => { const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (!cursorGlowRef.current) return; cursorGlowRef.current.style.transform = `translate(${e.clientX}px, ${e.clientY}px)`; }; window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove); return () => window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove); }, []); return ( <> {/* Cursor glow que sigue el mouse */} <div ref={cursorGlowRef} className="fixed pointer-events-none z-50 mix-blend-screen" style={{ width: '400px', height: '400px', marginLeft: '-200px', marginTop: '-200px', background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(226,253,108,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%)', filter: 'blur(60px)', transition: 'transform 0.15s ease-out', }} /> {/* Glow effects en elementos interactivos */} <style jsx global>{` .glow-button { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .glow-button::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient( circle at var(--mouse-x, 50%) var(--mouse-y, 50%), rgba(226, 253, 108, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50% ); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; } .glow-button:hover::before { opacity: 1; } /* Glow text effect */ .glow-text { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(226, 253, 108, 0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(226, 253, 108, 0.3), 0 0 30px rgba(226, 253, 108, 0.2); } `}</style> </> );};

Sistemas de Scroll Inteligente y Scrollytelling: El Mecanismo de la InmersiÃ³n



El "scroll inteligente" no es simplemente mover la pÃ¡gina hacia abajo; es un sistema de control de la narrativa donde el usuario dicta el ritmo de la historia. ðŸ§  2. El "Algoritmo de Matching" (Cloud Function)



Esta funciÃ³n se dispara cuando entra un nuevo request. Para el Mariachi de 900â‚¬, buscarÃ¡ grupos en Madrid que tengan disponibilidad, equipo propio y buenas reviews.



functions/src/dispatch/matchProviders.ts



typescript



import * as functions from 'firebase-functions';



import * as admin from 'firebase-admin';



export const onServiceRequested = functions.firestore



.document('service_requests/{requestId}')



.onCreate(async (snap, context) => {



const request = snap.data();



const db = admin.firestore();



// 1. Buscamos proveedores que encajen (Mariachi, Min 6 personas, Online)



const providersQuery = await db.collection('providers')



.where('services', 'array-contains', request.serviceDetails.category)



.where('status', '==', 'ONLINE')



.where('minGroupSize', '<=', request.serviceDetails.groupSize)



.get();



const candidates = providersQuery.docs.map(doc => {



const p = doc.data();



// Calculamos Score: (Distancia * 0.4) + (Rating * 0.6)



const score = calculateDistanceScore(p.location, request.deliveryLocation) + (p.rating * 20);



return { id: doc.id, ...p, score };



});



// 2. Ordenar por score y asignar



candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);



const bestMatch = candidates[0];



if (bestMatch) {



return snap.ref.update({



status: 'ASSIGNED',



assignedProviderId: bestMatch.id,



assignedProviderName: bestMatch.name,



assignedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()



});



} else {



// Si no hay nadie, alertar a Ops EAR



return admin.analytics().logEvent('DISPATCH_FAIL', { category: 'mariachi' });



}



});

// src/contexts/SuitContext.tsximport { createContext, useContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react';import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';type SuitType = 'classic' | 'architecture' | 'gamification';interface SuitContextType { activeSuit: SuitType; setActiveSuit: (suit: SuitType) => void; loading: boolean;}const SuitContext = createContext<SuitContextType | undefined>(undefined);export const SuitProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => { const [activeSuit, setActiveSuitState] = useState<SuitType>('classic'); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { // Cargar suit desde Firestore const loadActiveSuit = async () => { const docRef = doc(db, 'settings', 'ui'); const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef); if (docSnap.exists()) { setActiveSuitState(docSnap.data().activeSuit || 'classic'); } setLoading(false); }; loadActiveSuit(); }, []); const setActiveSuit = async (suit: SuitType) => { setActiveSuitState(suit); // Persistir en Firestore await setDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'ui'), { activeSuit: suit }); }; return ( <SuitContext.Provider value={{ activeSuit, setActiveSuit, loading }}> {children} </SuitContext.Provider> );};export const useSuit = () => { const context = useContext(SuitContext); if (!context) throw new Error('useSuit must be used within SuitProvider'); return context;};

); };export default App;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import Navbar from './components/Navbar';

import Hero from './components/Hero';

import ThreeDoors from './components/ThreeDoors';

import Features from './components/Features';

import AdditionalServices from './components/AdditionalServices';

import Stats from './components/Stats';

import Testimonials from './components/Testimonials';

import Footer from './components/Footer';

import ProfesorIA from './components/ProfesorIA';

import About from './components/About';

import Contact from './components/Contact';

import VideoServices from './components/VideoServices';

import Privacy from './components/Privacy';

import Blog from './components/Blog';

import WhatsAppButton from './components/WhatsAppButton';

import ReservationSystem from './components/ReservationSystem';

import TheEarSignal from './components/TheEarSignal';

import GamificationOverlay from './components/GamificationOverlay';

import OnboardingTour from './components/OnboardingTour';

import RentalSection from './components/RentalSection';

import EventsSection from './components/EventsSection';

import WeddingsSection from './components/WeddingsSection';

import ArtistsSection from './components/ArtistsSection';

import SocialProjects from './components/SocialProjects';

import AccessibilityWidget from './components/AccessibilityWidget';

import SocialImpactHome from './components/SocialImpactHome';

import BusinessServices from './components/BusinessServices';

import PricingTable from './components/PricingTable';





type ViewState = 'home' | 'profesoria' | 'about' | 'contact' | 'services' | 'privacy' | 'blog' | 'calculator' | 'booking' | 'signal' | 'rental' | 'events' | 'weddings' | 'artists' | 'social' | 'business' | 'pricing';





const App: React.FC = () => {

  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewState>('home');

  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0);

  const [level, setLevel] = useState(1);

  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [showTour, setShowTour] = useState(false);





  // --- GAMIFICATION LOGIC ---

  const addXp = (amount: number, reason: string) => {

    const newXp = xp + amount;

    setXp(newXp);

    const newLevel = Math.floor(newXp / 100) + 1;

    if (newLevel > level) {

      setLevel(newLevel);

    }

    setNotification(`+${amount} XP: ${reason}`);

    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 3000);

  };





  useEffect(() => {

    const hasVisited = localStorage.getItem('ear_visited');

    if (!hasVisited) {

      setTimeout(() => setShowTour(true), 1500);

      localStorage.setItem('ear_visited', 'true');

    }

  }, []);





  const handleNavigate = (newView: ViewState) => {

    if (newView === 'calculator') {

      setView('contact');

      return;

    }

    if (newView !== view) {

      addXp(10, `Explorando ${newView}`);

      setView(newView);

    }

  };





  const renderContent = () => {

    switch (view) {

      case 'profesoria': return <ProfesorIA onBack={() => handleNavigate('home')} />;

      case 'about': return <About />;

      case 'contact': return <Contact />;

      case 'services': return <VideoServices onNavigate={handleNavigate} />;

      case 'rental': return <RentalSection />;

      case 'events': return <EventsSection />;

      case 'weddings': return <WeddingsSection />;

      case 'artists': return <ArtistsSection />;

      case 'business': return <BusinessServices />;

      case 'pricing': return <PricingTable />;

      case 'social': return <SocialProjects />;

      case 'privacy': return <Privacy />;

      case 'blog': return <Blog />;

      case 'booking': return <ReservationSystem />;

      case 'signal': return <TheEarSignal />;

      case 'home':

      default:

        return (

          <main>

            <Hero />

            <Stats />

            <ThreeDoors

              onOpenTool={() => {

                addXp(50, "Herramienta IA Activada");

                handleNavigate('profesoria');

              }}

              onNavigate={handleNavigate}

            />

            <Features />

            <SocialImpactHome onNavigate={handleNavigate} />

            <AdditionalServices />

            <Testimonials />

          </main>

        );

    }

  };





  return (

    <div className="min-h-screen bg-black text-white selection:bg-ear-gold selection:text-black">

      <AccessibilityWidget />

      <GamificationOverlay xp={xp} level={level} notification={notification} onCloseNotification={() => setNotification(null)} />

      {showTour && <OnboardingTour onComplete={() => setShowTour(false)} />}

      <Navbar onNavigate={(v) => handleNavigate(v as ViewState)} />

      {renderContent()}

      <WhatsAppButton />

      <Footer onNavigate={(v) => handleNavigate(v as ViewState)} />

    </div>

  );

};





export default App;
